articles.summary: TriNet, a leading provider of comprehensive human resources solutions for small and medium-size businesses (SMBs), today announced the results of a new survey conducted with Harvard Business Review Analytic Services.
articles.title: Harvard Business Review Analytic Services Survey, Sponsored by TriNet, Finds SMBs Accelerating AI Adoption and Embracing New Opportunities for Workforce Skill Development

articles.summary: Today, at Transform, the premier global community shaping the future of people and work, TriNet announced strategic expansions to the TriNet platform that reflect how the future of work is reshaping the way teams are built, supported, and managed.
articles.title: TriNet Unveils Platform Innovations Purpose-Built for Today’s Small and Medium-Size Businesses
